In detail

The centre — the Old Town, Nowy Świat, the Palace of Culture, Dworzec Centralny — and the district that records the most crime in the city: 2,506 offences in the year to June 2024 in the police figures reported by the Warsaw press, with theft and nightlife brawls named as the main problems. Read that number with the obvious caveat: it is a count, not a rate, and Śródmieście has by far the most people walking through it. Property crime is what visitors actually meet in Warsaw — pickpocketing, and thefts from cars — and this is where the footfall is. Busy, well lit, and worth keeping a hand on your bag around the station and the bar streets after midnight.

This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Warsaw publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Śródmieście safe?

Wandroz currently rates Śródmieście in Warsaw as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Warsaw during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Warsaw at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Warsaw publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Śródmieście safe at night?

At night, Śródmieście is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Warsaw. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Śródmieście a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Śródmieście's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Warsaw) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Śródmieście?

Not an official government crime feed — Śródmieście's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
